name: Cassava, starch 66-70%
description: Dried cassava roots (Manihot esculentaCrantz), containing 66-70% starch (as fed). Cassava roots are usually provided as chips, pellets or meal (ground chips).

name: Vinasse, different origins
description: Humid product obtained by mixing the fermentation byproducts of different industries. This product has been concentrated and demineralised.

name: Maize bran, starch production
description: Byproduct of the manufacture of starch obtained from maize grain (Zea maysL.) by wet milling. It consists principally of the bran with some germ fragments.

name: Barley distillers grains, dried
description: Byproduct of alcohol (ethanol) manufacture, obtained from the distillery of barley grains (Hordeum vulgareL.), and consisting of spent grains with the soluble fraction added. Alternative spellings: barley distiller's grains, barley distillers' grains.

name: Beet pulp, pressed
description: Humid byproduct of sugar manufacture, obtained after extracting the juice from sugar beet roots (Beta vulgarisL.). The resulting solids are pressed to reduce water content down to 70-80%.

name: Vinasse, from yeast production, protein 48%
description: Humid byproduct of the production of bakery yeast from molasses. It should contain about 48% of crude protein (as fed, calculated as nitrogen x 6.25). It has been partly depotassified by action of ammonium sulfate.

name: Calcium carbonate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula CaCO3. It is commonly found in rocks, notably limestone (as calcite and aragonite), and it is the main component of marine shells. Calcium carbonate is used in animal feeding as a source of calcium.

name: Brewers yeast, dried
description: Dried byproduct of brewery, consisting of yeast (Saccharomyces cerevisiae) remaining in the fermentation vats of malt wort after removal of the fermented liquid. It is generally sold in dried form.

name: Rye
description: Rye grain (Secale cerealeL.).

name: Maize starch
description: Starch extracted from maize grain (Zea maysL.). Other name: corn starch (USA).

name: Alfalfa, dehydrated, protein 22-25% dry matter
description: Dehydrated aerial part of alfalfa (Medicago sativaL.), containing between 22% and 25% protein (in dry matter).

name: L-lysine HCl
description: Monochlorydrate of L-lysine obtained by fermentation from carbohydrate sources.

compositions.table: Brazilian Tables 5th ed. Table 1.09 (calculated from total amino acid × standardized digestibility)

name: Magnesium carbonate RG
description: Inorganic chemical compound (salt) with the formula MgCO3. This product is of reagent quality.

name: Fish oil, menhaden
description: Oil extracted from fish of the menhaden family (Brevoortiaspp.).

name: Sesame meal, oil > 5%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of sesame seeds (Sesamum indicumL.). This product has a high content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure only. Other name: sesame cake, sesame oil cake.

name: Soybean, whole, extruded
description: Extruded soybean seed (Glycine max(L.) Merr.). Other name: extruded full-fat soybean.

name: Cobalt oxide FG
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula CoO. This product is of feed grade quality. Other names: cobalt(II) oxide, cobalt monoxide.

name: Zinc lysine
description: Lysine and zinc complex used as a source of organic zinc. These products have a variable zinc content.

name: Whey powder, sweet
description: Dried byproduct of the manufacturing of pressed cheese. Whey is the liquid that separates from the curd.

name: Blood meal
description: Dried slaughterhouse byproduct, obtained by collecting and drying the blood of slaughtered warm-blooded animals. Note: it is recommended to check the regulatory status of this product before using it for livestock feeding.
